summary: Backend passes 6/7 (1 minor: 500 vs 422 on invalid payload inside SyncEvent). Full end-to-end mobile flow works: onboarding -> workspace -> account -> add-expense via FAB -> ledger -> budgets -> spending -> sync. FAB is now visible and clickable at 390x844 (bottom=700, well within viewport). HOWEVER a NEW critical web-preview bug found: the BottomSheetForm modal is rendered ~1357px below the top (well outside the 844px viewport) so its Save button (testID=sheet-save) is unreachable via a normal tap; the click succeeds only via JS. Deprecated style warnings observed: 'shadow*' style props (should be boxShadow) and 'pointerEvents' prop (should be style.pointerEvents).

minor.issue: When a SyncEvent payload has amount_minor<=0 the endpoint returns HTTP 500 (unhandled Pydantic ValidationError on nested TransactionIn) instead of 400/422. Wrap TransactionIn(**event.payload) in try/except and raise HTTPException(422).

ui_bugs.issue: On web preview at 390x844 the Modal renders outside the viewport: sheet top y≈1357, sheet-save y≈1421 while viewport height is 844. The user cannot tap Save. Playwright confirms 'Element is outside of the viewport' unless bypassed via JS click. Likely cause: RN <Modal> portal in RN-web sizes to document height (not viewport). Fix: replace Modal with an in-tree absolutely-positioned overlay (View style={position:'absolute', inset:0, justifyContent:'flex-end'}) or wrap the KeyboardAvoidingView in a fixed-position container with height:100vh (web only). Applies to workspace, account, expense, and budget sheets.

integration_issues.issue: Could not exercise sync-error-banner because backend is healthy in this environment. Behavior of banner is only reachable via induced failure (e.g., invalid EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Consider adding a hidden dev toggle to force-fail sync for QA, or a mocked failure test. Success path verified (Synced 1 change toast + outbox cleared).

issues: Cancel button is at the bottom of scroll content — with the sheet already offscreen the user has no way to dismiss it on web.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:211-214 (fab shadow*) and likely other primitives.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — check @/src/shared/ui components (e.g., Toast/BottomSheetForm/Primitives).

action_items: Fix web Modal off-viewport bug in BottomSheetForm — this blocks tap-based Save on web preview. Suggested: on Platform.OS === 'web' render an in-tree overlay instead of RN <Modal>, or wrap the KeyboardAvoidingView so its parent has height:100vh.
Wrap nested TransactionIn construction in POST /api/sync with proper 422 error handling.
Add a QA hook or test for sync-error-banner (currently only reachable via network failure).
critical_code_review_comments: FinanceProvider.sync reads process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — good (matches frontend/.env). Backend test suite still relies on EXPO_BACKEND_URL for BASE_URL; consider aligning env var names project-wide.

server.py /api/sync happily accepts an empty list (returns []). Fine, but no per-event isolation: a single bad payload will 500 the entire batch instead of returning partial results — consider try/except per event and returning a structured accepted/rejected response.
BottomSheetForm 'Cancel' is inside the ScrollView content — if the sheet is small it renders below the fold and users may not see it.

rca_of_issue: React Native <Modal> renders via a portal on react-native-web. The backdrop uses flex:1 + justifyContent:flex-end, but the portal container inherits document (not viewport) height on web, so 'flex-end' pushes the sheet to the document bottom (~y=1357) rather than the visual viewport bottom (~y=844). Reproduction: open the preview URL at 390x844, create a workspace, then tap testID create-workspace — the sheet appears mostly below the fold; scroll the outer page down to see it, or measure via getBoundingClientRect on [data-testid=sheet-save]. Mitigation: for web, replace <Modal> with an absolutely-positioned overlay inside the app root (position:absolute, top:0, bottom:0, left:0, right:0) or use position:'fixed', height:'100vh' on the modal container.
